verdicts.reason: A: the NEW FLAVOR badge has shrunk until it can't be read. The body copy is squeezed into a narrow 5-line column ('Botanical / sparkling / infusions…') and sits as a stray fragment beside the CTA. The two-line headline runs into the background circle, and the SOLSTICE logo is tiny and cut off from the rest of the brand area, so the layout reads as scattered pieces. B: reads cleanly from left to right. The headline is on one line, with the subcopy and CTA grouped under it on a shared centre axis. Its flaws are that the badge is bigger than the logo and crowds it inside the faded circle, the large left circle makes the composition lopsided, and the can's label text is too small to read.
